name: plant-uml-web
description: Plant UML Editor with py-sc-client, py-sc-kpm,sc-web,js-scs-editor

scripts.build:sc-web: npm install && cd external/sc-web && npm install && npm run build && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all-linux: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && npm install && cd external/sc-web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all-win: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt && npm install && cd external\sc-web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.test:js: cd tests_js && npm install && npm test
